steps.text: An engineer pushes to main.
Changes under apps/api start the ci workflow. It builds the image and fails on HIGH or CRITICAL CVEs.
On main, ci pushes the image to ECR, tagged with the commit SHA.
Changes under charts/ or envs/ start the helm workflow. It lints and renders the chart for dev and prod.
On main, helm packages the chart and pushes it to ECR as an OCI artifact.
Argo CD polls main. Git is the only way changes reach the cluster.
webapp-dev renders charts/webapp with envs/dev values into gitops-dev.
webapp-prod renders the same chart with envs/prod values into gitops-prod.
The api Application applies k8s/api: Deployment, Service, ServiceMonitor, alert rules and dashboard.
The logging Application applies the Elasticsearch, Kibana and Beat resources. The ECK operator builds them.
The browser reaches ingress-nginx through port-forward 8080 with Host gitops-prod.localhost.
The Ingress rule sends the request to the webapp Service in gitops-prod, which picks one of 3 pods.
For ExitZero, the browser posts the pasted error to /ask on port 8001.
ExitZero ranks runbook entries with keyword and embedding search and returns the best match.
On main, ci and helm trade their GitHub OIDC token for the github-actions-terraform role. The credentials last for one job.
On pull requests, terraform-plan gets the github-actions-plan role, which is read-only.
In the cluster, ECK creates the Elasticsearch credentials and hands them to Filebeat and Kibana. Nobody writes a Secret by hand.
Prometheus finds the API through its ServiceMonitor, scrapes /metrics every 15s and evaluates 4 alert rules.
Grafana queries Prometheus. The API dashboard is a ConfigMap the sidecar loads by label.
The API writes one JSON line per event to stdout. Filebeat tails the container log files on the node.
Filebeat keeps only the api namespace, decodes each line into fields and ships it to Elasticsearch.
Kibana searches the stored logs by level, logger, pod or message.
A pull request that touches infra/terraform runs terraform-plan.
The plan reads state from S3 without taking the lock, so it never blocks an apply.
An engineer applies the network stack from a laptop: VPC, subnets, internet gateway and NAT.
The eks stack reads the private subnet IDs from network state and creates the cluster there. It is destroyed after each session.

nodes.title: Engineer
nodes.subtitle: kubectl, terraform
nodes.description: Pushes code, applies the AWS stacks with Terraform, and reaches the local cluster with kubectl port-forward.

nodes.title: Browser
nodes.subtitle: localhost
nodes.description: Opens the prod webapp through the ingress controller, and ExitZero on port 8001.

nodes.title: Git repo
nodes.subtitle: main branch
nodes.description: The source of truth. CI builds from it and Argo CD syncs the cluster from it.

nodes.title: ci workflow
nodes.subtitle: on apps/api/**
nodes.description: Builds the API image and fails on HIGH or CRITICAL CVEs. Pushes to ECR on main only.

nodes.title: helm workflow
nodes.subtitle: on charts/, envs/
nodes.description: Lints and renders the chart for dev and prod. On main it packages the chart and pushes it to ECR.

nodes.title: terraform-plan
nodes.subtitle: on PRs to infra/
nodes.description: Runs fmt, validate and plan on pull requests that touch infra/terraform.

nodes.title: IAM OIDC roles
nodes.subtitle: GitHub token to STS
nodes.description: GitHub's OIDC token is exchanged for short-lived AWS credentials, so no AWS keys are stored in GitHub.

nodes.title: ECR
nodes.subtitle: api + charts/webapp
nodes.description: Holds the API image and the packaged chart. The kind cluster does not pull from here yet; the EKS deploy will.

nodes.title: S3 state
nodes.subtitle: state + lockfile
nodes.description: Terraform state for bootstrap, network and eks, one key per stack, locked with an S3 lockfile.

nodes.title: VPC network
nodes.subtitle: 4 subnets · 1 NAT
nodes.description: Two public and two private subnets across ap-south-1a and 1b, an internet gateway, and one NAT gateway for private egress.

nodes.title: EKS cluster
nodes.subtitle: 2 x t3.small nodes
nodes.description: Control plane and a managed node group in the private subnets. Created for a lab session, then destroyed to save cost.

nodes.title: Argo CD
nodes.subtitle: ns argocd
nodes.description: Polls main and applies what Git says. Four Applications, all with automated sync, prune and self-heal.

nodes.title: ingress-nginx
nodes.subtitle: ns ingress-nginx
nodes.description: Routes requests by Host header to the prod webapp Service.

nodes.title: webapp dev
nodes.subtitle: ns gitops-dev
nodes.description: The Helm chart with dev values: 2 replicas, debug logging, no Ingress. Reached with port-forward on 8081.

nodes.title: Platform API
nodes.subtitle: ns api · FastAPI
nodes.description: Small FastAPI service with /health and /metrics. Logs JSON to stdout. On kind it runs a locally loaded image.

nodes.title: webapp prod
nodes.subtitle: ns gitops-prod
nodes.description: The same chart with prod values: 3 replicas, resource limits and an Ingress.

nodes.title: Grafana
nodes.subtitle: ns monitoring
nodes.description: Dashboards query Prometheus. The API dashboard is a ConfigMap that the sidecar picks up by label.

nodes.title: Prometheus
nodes.subtitle: ns monitoring
nodes.description: Finds the API through its ServiceMonitor, scrapes /metrics every 15s and evaluates 4 alert rules.

nodes.title: Filebeat
nodes.subtitle: ns logging · per node
nodes.description: Tails container logs on each node, keeps only the api namespace, and decodes each JSON line into fields.

nodes.title: Elasticsearch
nodes.subtitle: ns logging · 1 node
nodes.description: Stores the API logs. It has one node, so health is yellow: replica shards have nowhere to go.

nodes.title: ECK operator
nodes.subtitle: ns logging · CRs
nodes.description: Turns the Elasticsearch, Kibana and Beat resources into pods, and creates the credentials they use to talk to each other.

nodes.title: Kibana
nodes.subtitle: ns logging
nodes.description: Search and filter the API logs by level, logger, pod or message.

nodes.title: Runbooks
nodes.subtitle: knowledge/*.md
nodes.description: 248 entries across 46 tools. Each lists the exact error strings, the cause, the fix and the commands to run.

nodes.title: ExitZero
nodes.subtitle: FastAPI · local only
nodes.description: Paste an error, get the matching runbook: cause, fix and commands. Runs locally with uvicorn for now.
